text:
joanne_fin: Riverbend flagged invoice 87210 (TKT-8801). They were double-billed for a Dedicated reservation during a region migration. Asking for a $7,500 refund + corrected invoice.

tyler_csm: ouch. can you paste invoice lines? need SKU and region tag for the memo.

joanne_fin: invoice excerpt:
```
Invoice 87210
- Dedicated reserved Americas (RB-DED-AMER): $15,000
- Dedicated reserved EMEA (RB-DED-EMEA): $7,500
- Usage & overage: $1,100
- Discounts: $0
Total: $23,600
```

tyler_csm: they migrated EMEA to a new account mid-cycle; EMEA should've been billed to new account 4002, not 3999. So net due on this invoice should be $16,100 (remove EMEA $7,500).

maria_billing: need approval for corrective refund of $7,500 and reissue invoice 87210-R1. GL for reversal?

jvp_fin: approve one-time refund $7,500 (GL 5200: Billing adjustments - refunds). Please note: reason "double-billed during region migration; TKT-8801". Also add a memo for inter-account transfer so AR is balanced.

billing-bot: Credit memo CM-2026-0833 created for $7,500. Reissued invoice 87210-R1 (net due $16,100). Link: https://billing.internal/reports/invoice/87210-R1

maria_billing: emailed CM + corrected invoice to customer and ops. Also created internal journal entry to move the EMEA charge to account 4002 so revenue mapping remains correct. Logging this under month-end exceptions.

joanne_fin: thanks everyone. asking sales-ops to add a migration checklist to avoid cross-account charges during cutovers. closing once Riverbend confirms receipt. :white_check_mark:
